name: Kisaragi Shizuma
source:
[url=/c1344]Natsuki[/url]'s and [url=/c1348]Koori[/url]'s "bad friend". Cool and popular.

Reels off on his word, helping, but a bit to honest. Socializes well, has a lot of friends.

[Edited from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=31461]Getchu[/url]]

[spoiler]Actually, he is a girl that was raised as a boy because of family consequences.  [url=/c1344]Natsuki[/url] knows her secret but still tries to behave with her like she's a boy.[/spoiler]
